results.query: what is the Soul Sync meditation
results.response: Soul Sync is a powerful and transformative practice, created by Sri Preethaji, that goes beyond traditional meditation. It is designed to help you awaken to beautiful states of being and to draw upon the limitless power of consciousness to manifest your heartfelt intentions. This practice is both scientific and mystical. It involves six steps that help to silence the mind, calm your nervous system, and expand your awareness. The ancient sages of India spoke of an expansive consciousness called "Brahma Garbha," which Soul Sync helps to activate, making your intentions powerful enough to manifest. It can also be used to transform a warring self into a beautiful, peaceful self, fostering inner harmony. Watch more here: Ekam OFF 2018 Presentation Video | pkconsciousness
